verdict.rationale: The docs confirm the API has a separate sandbox environment alongside live, so developers can test before going live. Nothing in the pack documents test documents, personas, or magic values that reliably force pass, fail, or review outcomes. missing for 10: documented test documents/personas/magic values, deterministic pass/fail/review (consider) result simulation, coverage of all report types in sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results

citations.quote: The Entrust Identity Verification API uses OAuth access and token-based authentication for both its sandbox and live environments.
